purpose: Five investigation board concept arts for comparison.

concepts.title: Сталь и магниты
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a high-fidelity concept art of an interactive investigation board for the Russian detective game website DETECTUM. This is ONE complete board concept, not a collage or style guide.
Composition: landscape 3:2, perfectly straight-on flat front view, whole rectangular board visible, board filling about 88% of the picture below one slim tasteful app toolbar. An immediately usable interface with generous empty board space, elegant Russian typography and extremely crisp tactile photorealistic materials. Five paper notes at staggered positions and two small monochrome evidence photographs, connected by four fine realistic twisted red threads. Threads visibly cross above the papers and pass behind the attachment objects. Keep a central pink note and smaller cream, blue, green and pale yellow notes around it; slight paper rotations, subtle depth and natural small shadows. Avoid dense clutter; keep labels clearly readable.
Exact toolbar text: "ДЕТЕКТУМ" at left, "Доска расследования", one restrained "Добавить" button at right. Small unobtrusive minus and plus zoom control in the bottom right.
Exact note title text, once each: "Вероника Гронская", "Илона", "Редакция", "Бар «Алмаз»", "Расписание". Under each title add one short restrained handwritten line or two, never dense blocks. Photographs show an empty city street and an anonymous building, no portrait subjects.
Style: premium art direction for a believable detective game, realistic sharp material detail and excellent readability, restrained cinematic lighting, attractive but functional. Paper, mounts and red threads must be separate visually understandable layers. This is a visual concept only, no browser chrome, no laptop, no people, no hands, no watermark, no extra logos, no split panels, no infographic annotations, no explanatory text outside the design.
Design direction: worn gray magnetic sheet steel with a narrow matte gunmetal frame and small corner screws. The steel is smooth and softly brushed, sparse tiny rust flecks and fine restrained scratches, no coarse concrete grain or heavy noise. The notes are secured with beautiful round enamel disc magnets in forest green, dark navy, faded burgundy, mustard and ivory. Muted pastel paper and crisp black handwritten titles. Warm subtle upper-left light, moody charcoal toolbar with cream typography, a bronze accent on the add button. Contemporary but tactile, very close to a real mid-century office magnetic board. This concept must clearly read as a steel magnetic board.

Design direction: urban detective evidence board made of a precise blackened steel wire grid, squares about 30mm, suspended in a very thin charcoal industrial frame over a dark muted olive-gray backing. Grid remains low-contrast, clear and straight; it must not look like a fence outdoors. Notes, slightly weathered off-white dossiers and the two small monochrome photos are held by tiny black and aged brass binder clips attached to the mesh with unobtrusive hooks. No magnets and no thumbtacks. The fine red cords anchor at the clips and weave across the evidence. Introduce a small ivory evidence envelope and a restrained numbered archive label as believable stationery details. Warm directional light and crisp fine shadows, realistic analog noir craftsmanship, premium functional urban evidence-wall aesthetic. Dark slim toolbar, cream lettering, understated brass add button. Full front view, complete board, no tilted camera.
